name: Moreno Valley Plaza
demographics: Moreno Valley Plaza serves a diverse, family-oriented community in the Inland Empire with a predominantly middle-income demographic. The trade area attracts households with children seeking convenient shopping for everyday needs, with visitors typically ranging from young families to middle-aged adults. The center draws from Moreno Valley's growing population of approximately 200,000+ residents, characterized by value-conscious shoppers who prioritize accessibility and practical retail options over luxury experiences.
description: Moreno Valley Plaza is a well-established community shopping destination located at 23715 Sunnymead Boulevard in Moreno Valley, California. Serving the rapidly growing Inland Empire region, this open-air shopping center has become a cornerstone of the local retail landscape, offering residents convenient access to everyday shopping needs and services. With a strong 4.2-star rating from over 2,000 reviews, the plaza has earned its reputation as a family-friendly destination where visitors can enjoy a comfortable shopping experience. The center's accessible layout and ample parking make it easy for families to navigate, though shoppers are advised to exercise caution in the parking lot due to traffic flow. Customer feedback consistently highlights the friendly staff and quality service across the plaza's diverse tenant mix, making it a reliable choice for both routine errands and leisurely shopping trips in the Moreno Valley community.
summary: Moreno Valley Plaza is a popular community shopping center on Sunnymead Boulevard, serving the Inland Empire with convenient retail options and family-friendly amenities.
